name: Histopathology & immunohistochemistry

fields.before: "Looking at cancer cells under a microscope and staining them for specific proteins. Still the foundation of every diagnosis."
fields.after: "Histopathology means looking at cancer cells under a microscope, and immunohistochemistry stains them for specific proteins. Together they are still the foundation of every diagnosis."
